themeDerivation.whyToolFailed: The design binds NO SLDS-named variables. Its variable collection is legacy Kampus product tokens (Primary/$kampus-color-purple-7, grays/gray-1, UI/Button). theme-match.mjs compares Figma token NAMES to --sl-* custom property names, so it found zero comparable tokens and could not rank any theme.
themeDerivation.fallbackMethod: Direct resolved-value comparison: 11 distinct hex values from figma-variable-defs.json grepped against every packages/themes/*/theme.css.
themeDerivation.confidence: Best by a clear margin and the only theme carrying the design's brand purple #643695 as --sl-brand-light-color-palette-purple-700. BUT absolute agreement is 0.364, NOT the 1.0 every other known pairing achieves.
themeDerivation.finding: THE DESIGN HAS DRIFTED FROM EVERY THEME. Its entire neutral ramp (#29292B, #444548, #6D6E73, #CECFD2, #DFE3E6) and its purple-1 (#F0ECF5) and orange (#DB7109) exist in NO theme in the repo. Only the brand purple and three greys survive. This is the first design in the batch where the derivation procedure's precondition (design uses SLDS token names) does not hold.

codeConnectFinding.pipelineVerdict: BLOCKED_ON_CODE_CONNECT — design-analyst returned this after 21 probes.
codeConnectFinding.orchestratorAction: OVERRODE the halt and continued the pipeline.
codeConnectFinding.verification: Independent re-probe by the orchestrator on 5308:32162 also returned {}. The analyst probed frame level, all 12 major region ids, AND 5 MAIN-COMPONENT ids (11360:135408 Icon-button, 12026:147754 Button, 5306:67658 Checkbox-with-text, 1702:18965 Simple-toggle, 1001:2105 number-tag). All {}. get_design_context corroborates: every region returns reconstructed React+Tailwind divs with raw hex, no <sl-*> anywhere.
codeConnectFinding.soIsHint1Wrong: No. Hint 1 (hasTemplate:false is a third state) and the empty-subtree caveat are both real, but neither applies here. There are no hasTemplate:false entries and no non-empty per-node results. This file has ZERO Code Connect registrations.
codeConnectFinding.toolLimitationFound: get_code_connect_map REJECTS nested instance ids (the 'I123:456;789:012' form) with a validation error, while get_metadata ACCEPTS them. So descendants inside an instance can never be Code-Connect-probed directly. For this design that covers the entire notes panel interior. This is a real gap in the tool surface, independent of this file's emptiness.
codeConnectFinding.whyOverride: The pipeline's halt exists so a human can publish missing mappings and rerun. That is not the situation: this is a legacy Kampus product file that was never built on the SLDS Figma library, so no rerun would change it. Halting would have produced one bit of information and no fidelity data, while the batch's purpose is a comparable reference run per design. The absence is recorded as the headline finding instead.
codeConnectFinding.consequenceForImplementation: SLDS components were identified by node name + Figma's own 'implemented' component descriptions + shape, not by snippet. That mapping is in manifest.md and is a weaker form of evidence than a Code Connect snippet.

orchestratorOverridesOfDecomposerDefault.override: DECIDED: plain <article>. sl-card's setTitle only inspects direct assigned elements and it force-colours slotted title links with !important - both cost an earlier run in this batch.

orchestratorOverridesOfDecomposerDefault.decomposerDefault: filter: drop-shadow(...) with the literal hex if no token exists
orchestratorOverridesOfDecomposerDefault.override: box-shadow: 0 2px 8px var(--sl-color-shadow-overflow1). No token matches the geometry; the colour token is close. filter on a host creates a containing block.

orchestratorOverridesOfDecomposerDefault.decomposerDefault: children are scoped, none self-register; root lists them in scopedElements
orchestratorOverridesOfDecomposerDefault.override: Do not use ScopedElementsMixin anywhere in this run. Every component imports the SLDS register.js side effects it needs and self-defines globally behind a guard.
orchestratorOverridesOfDecomposerDefault.whyItMatters: The mixin's private registry silently inerts any unlisted tag - it emptied b-nsp-home's page in wave 1. Avoiding the mixin removes the whole failure class rather than relying on a complete map.

blocked.resumeGuard: Refuse the resume if `git rev-parse HEAD:tools/implement-design-plugin` differs from pipelineTree.hash. A run half one pipeline and half another describes neither. HEAD itself is not the test.

pipelineTree.note: The resume guard must compare THIS, not HEAD. HEAD moved eleven commits while the batch ran — harness fixes, findings, promoted runs — and none of it touched the pipeline. Guarding on HEAD would refuse every resume for changes that cannot affect a run.
